ScientificClaim.claimText: 20 mRNAs have been identified as potential breast cancer biomarkers with diagnostic performance (AUC >= 0.9 and p < 0.0001) from a differential expression analysis of 526 breast cancer tissue samples and 60 adjacent non-cancerous breast tissue samples.

RationaleArtifact.rationaleText: The claim is based on the identification of 1,445 mRNAs that are significantly differentially expressed (p > 3) in both breast cancer and adjacent non-cancerous tissue samples. From this pool, 20 mRNAs were selected with high diagnostic performance (AUC >= 0.9).
RationaleArtifact.keyEvidenceSummary: 1,445 mRNAs identified as significantly differentially expressed; 20 DE mRNAs with AUC >= 0.9 and p < 0.0001.
uncertainties: The validity of these biomarkers needs further experimental validation.
The diagnostic performance may vary in different populations.
